description: Dieter Most and university co-authors describe in the plan4res Case Study 1 report a completed modelling exercise linking MIM investment analysis, DMEM electricity-market and transmission operation, and gas-network optimisation. More than 100 technology types are represented in multimodal transition scenarios. Aggregated pathways are checked at finer spatial resolution for a 2040 operational focus, with reported grid bottlenecks, adjusted dispatch and candidate power-to-gas locations. Gas-flow checks explore hydrogen injection and the gas network’s transport role. These are scenario and proof-of-concept results, not observations of a realised carbon-neutral European system. Zenodo supplies the report freely under CC BY 4.0. Coverage is pan-European; exact model zones, cost assumptions and uncertainty bounds are not listed in the metadata inspected. Related plan4res model and data records preserve component roles. A limitation is that no report body or numerical outputs were read and the conclusions were not independently reproduced.
